 "rationale": "Iin=Iout=20uA, 40uA total. Sooch-style cascode with one series resistor R biasing the cascode gates. The bottom pair is long (L~2, Vds~0.12 V); the cascodes sit at gm/Id~22. In weak inversion the stacked pair compresses as I/I0≈1-exp(-Vout/UT), giving ~3UT≈80mV compliance, below 0.156 V. Rout≈gm_c·ro_c·ro1, about 15-30 MΩ. The bottom Vds values match, which keeps the error well below 0.65%."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # bottom mirror pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # bottom pair L (ro, matching)
    "gmidc": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),     # cascode gm/Id (deep weak inversion -> low Vdsat)
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # cascode L
    "vds1":  (0.12, 0.08, 0.20),     # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec["iin"]
    vds1 = p["vds1"]
    # bottom devices (input & output identical -> ratio 1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source at vds1 (body effect included)
    mc_in = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=max(m1.vgs - vds1 + 0.0, 0.25), vsb=vds1)
    mc_out = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=spec["vout_nom"] - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    # cascode gate = Vgs1 + I*R ; Vds1 = Vg_c - Vgs_c  ->  R = (vds1 + Vgs_c - Vgs1)/I
    R = (vds1 + mc_in.vgs - m1.vgs) / I
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e6)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> nd (drain of input cascode), gate of bottom pair at nd
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nd", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "nd", "iin", "x1", "vss", mc_in)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nd", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch: same W/L for cascode as input (use input sizing for exact match)
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", mc_in)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nd", "vss", "vss", m1)

    # predictions
    gds1 = max(m1.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = (mc_out.gm + mc_out.gmbs) / max(mc_out.gds, 1e-12) / gds1 + 1.0 / gds1
    # Vds mismatch of cascodes (nd ~ Vgs1+ vs 0.9) -> residual dVx = dVd_c / (gm_c ro_c)
    dvd = spec["vout_nom"] - m1.vgs
    gain_c = (mc_out.gm + mc_out.gmbs) / max(mc_out.gds, 1e-12)
    dvx = dvd / max(gain_c, 1.0)
    err = 100.0 * (gds1 * dvx) / I
    vcomp = 3 * 0.02585 + max(0.0, 2.0 / p["gmidc"] - 0.05)
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
